shiro.name: Shiro
shiro.blurb: A plain little call duck. Perfect as it is.
shiro.look: no outfit at all: just the plain white duck

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.blurb: Ready for the open sea, or at least the pond.
sailor.look: a small navy sailor collar with white stripes and a red bow, and a tiny white sailor cap

neko.name: Neko
neko.blurb: A cat-ear hoodie. Duck or cat? Yes.
neko.look: a soft gray cat-ear hoodie with the hood up around its face

super.name: Goku
super.blurb: Charges up for three episodes before every session.
super.look: spiky golden hair standing straight up like flames, and an orange martial-arts top with a dark-blue belt

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.look: a charcoal ninja hood with a long red headband tied at the back

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.blurb: Keeps its secrets. Also its flashcards.
kitsune.look: a white fox mask with red markings worn tilted on the side of its head, small orange fox ears, and a red scarf

yukata.name: Matsuri
yukata.look: an indigo summer yukata with a simple white wave pattern, a red obi sash, and a pink flower on its head

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.blurb: A tiny warrior in a very big helmet.
samurai.look: a little red samurai helmet with a golden crescent crest, and a dark-blue jacket

king.name: King
king.blurb: Rules the pond. Earned every minute.
king.look: a small golden crown and a red cape with a white fur collar

astro.name: Astro
astro.blurb: Studied so much it reached space.
astro.look: a white space suit and a round clear glass helmet bubble around its head

shizuku.name: Shizuku
shizuku.blurb: Every session is a stage. No encore needed.
shizuku.look: Shizuku Osaka from Love Live! Nijigasaki: long straight dark-brown hair with neat bangs flowing down behind its back, tied in a half-up ponytail with her big red ribbon bow at the back of the head, and a light-blue idol outfit with white frills

nurse.name: Nurse
nurse.blurb: Takes care of everyone, starting with your focus.
nurse.look: a small white nurse cap with a red cross, a pale pink nurse collar, and a stethoscope around its neck

senku.name: Senku
senku.look: Senku from Dr. Stone: tall spiky upswept white hair with pale green tips, the thin stone-crack marks on one side of his face, a simple light-green caveman tunic, and a small glass flask of bubbling green liquid

naruto.name: Naruto
naruto.blurb: Believe it: one more session, dattebayo.
naruto.look: Naruto: spiky bright-yellow hair, a blue Leaf Village headband with a metal plate, three whisker marks on each cheek, and an orange-and-black jacket

loid.name: Loid
loid.blurb: Mission: study hard, blend in. Mostly the first one.
loid.look: Loid Forger from Spy x Family: short neat blond hair swept to the side, a dark-green suit jacket over a black vest, a white shirt and a red tie

yor.name: Yor
yor.blurb: Assassinates distractions. Cooking is another matter.
yor.look: Yor Forger as the Thorn Princess from Spy x Family: long straight black hair with bangs and two long locks in front, a golden rose headband, a black off-the-shoulder dress with red roses, and a small gold stiletto

anya.name: Anya
anya.look: Anya Forger from Spy x Family: shoulder-length pink hair with her two little black cone-shaped hair ornaments on top, and her black Eden Academy school dress with gold trim

kirby.name: Kirby
kirby.blurb: Inhales whole chapters in one go.
kirby.look: Kirby: a cute round pink Kirby kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with Kirby's face on top of the hood (two tall dark-blue oval eyes with a white shine, pink blush and a tiny smile), and a small star scarf

vegeta.name: Vegeta
vegeta.blurb: It's over 9,000 minutes! Still not satisfied.
vegeta.look: Vegeta from Dragon Ball Z: tall black spiky flame-shaped hair with a sharp widow's peak, a blue bodysuit with white Saiyan armour and yellow shoulder pads

clive.name: Clive
clive.blurb: Burns through the reading list. Literally.
clive.look: Clive Rosfield from Final Fantasy XVI: short dark-brown hair, a short dark beard, a plain dark cape over his shoulders (no fur) on his dark leather outfit, and a big sword hilt over his shoulder

sonic.name: Sonic
sonic.look: Sonic the Hedgehog: a blue Sonic hood with his big swept-back blue quills and little blue ears framing the duck's face, and a small gold ring floating beside it

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.blurb: Carries a sword as big as the syllabus.
cloud.look: Cloud Strife from Final Fantasy VII: tall spiky blond hair, a dark navy sleeveless SOLDIER top with a silver shoulder pauldron, and his huge Buster Sword strapped upright on his back

sora.name: Sora
sora.blurb: Unlocks every chapter with a Keyblade.
sora.look: Sora from Kingdom Hearts 2: big spiky brown hair, an all-black short-sleeved hooded jacket with white lining and silver patches on the shoulders, a navy undershirt with a red patch in the middle, his silver crown pendant necklace, and the Kingdom Key Keyblade resting upright behind him

venus.name: Venus
venus.blurb: In the name of the moon, you will finish this chapter.
venus.look: Sailor Venus: long golden-blonde hair with a big red bow, a gold tiara with an orange gem, an orange choker, and her white sailor uniform with an orange collar and a blue front bow

yu.name: Yu
yu.look: Yu Narukami from Persona 4 Revival: neat straight silver-gray hair with a bob and bangs (only medium-gray lines inside the hair, never black), and the black Yasogami High school jacket with a high collar, worn open over a white shirt

makoto.name: Makoto
makoto.look: Makoto Yuki from Persona 3 Reload: dark blue hair with long bangs swept over one side of the face (the duck's own eye stays visible), the black Gekkoukan High blazer with a white shirt and red ribbon, a red S.E.E.S. armband, small gray clip-on earphones resting at his collar (not on the ear) with a black cable down to a small gray cylindrical MP3 player hanging on his chest

joker.name: Joker
joker.look: Joker from Persona 5: messy black curly hair, his white domino mask (the duck's eye shows through it), and his black Phantom Thief long coat with a high collar

kiryu.name: Kiryu
kiryu.blurb: Never skips a session. Or a karaoke night.
kiryu.look: Kazuma Kiryu from Yakuza: short slicked-back dark hair, a light gray suit over an open-collared dark red shirt

link.name: Link
link.blurb: Hey! Listen! Every session is another dungeon cleared.
link.look: Link from The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess: his long floppy olive-green cap with the tip hanging down behind the head, light golden-brown hair with long side bangs, an olive-green tunic with a brown leather belt over a light chainmail collar, and on his back the Hylian Shield (blue with a silver rim, a silver Triforce and the red bird crest) with the Master Sword's blue-violet hilt sticking up over the shoulder

zelda.name: Zelda
zelda.blurb: Wisdom, one session at a time. Courage is your problem.
zelda.look: Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess: long straight brown hair with bangs and two long front locks wrapped in white bands, a gold tiara with a blue gem on the forehead, ornate gold shoulder pieces, and a white royal gown with lilac panels and a tabard down the front showing a gold Triforce above a red crest

miku.name: Miku
miku.blurb: Hums along to every session. The first sound of a focused future.
miku.look: Hatsune Miku: very long turquoise twin tails tied high on the head with black-and-red hair ties, turquoise bangs, a black headset with turquoise lights and a small microphone, and her gray sleeveless top's collar with a turquoise necktie

bocchi.name: Bocchi
bocchi.blurb: Practices for hours and talks to no one. The perfect study buddy.
bocchi.look: Hitori 'Bocchi' Gotoh from Bocchi the Rock!: long straight pink hair with bangs down to just above the eye, her two little square hair clips on top of the head, one blue and one yellow, a pink tracksuit jacket zipped up to the collar, and a black electric guitar on her back

monika.name: Monika
monika.look: Monika from Doki Doki Literature Club!: long coral-brown hair in a high ponytail tied with a big white bow at the back, neat bangs with two long strands framing the face, and her school uniform: a warm gray blazer over a white shirt with a red ribbon at the collar

trunks.name: Trunks
trunks.blurb: Came back from the future to make sure you study.
trunks.look: Future Trunks from Dragon Ball Z: straight lavender hair down to the chin with a middle part, a steel-blue jacket with a small Capsule Corp logo patch on the shoulder over a black shirt, and his sword's hilt sticking up over the shoulder from a brown strap across the chest

godzilla.name: Godzilla
godzilla.blurb: King of the Monsters, and of the pond.
godzilla.look: Godzilla: a charcoal gray-green Godzilla kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with Godzilla's snout and a row of small white teeth along the top of the hood, and pale jagged dorsal plates running from the hood down the duck's back

snoopy.name: Snoopy
snoopy.look: Snoopy from Peanuts: two long black floppy dog ears hanging down from the top of the head on both sides, a red collar, and a tiny yellow Woodstock bird sitting on top of its head

ike.name: Ike
ike.blurb: Fights for his friends. Studies for himself.
ike.look: young Ike from Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (his Path of Radiance costume): spiky dark-blue hair, a dark brown headband with long tails trailing behind, a red cape wrapped around his shoulders like a scarf, a brown leather guard on his shoulder, a navy-blue tunic with a high collar, and his sword Ragnell strapped upright on his back: a broad golden-yellow blade with a dark gray crossguard and grip

witch.name: Witch
witch.blurb: Out trick-or-treating. The bucket is mostly flashcards.
witch.look: a Halloween witch: a tall floppy black pointed witch hat with a purple band and a small buckle, a short black cape with a purple lining, and a little orange jack-o'-lantern treat pail resting against its wing, with a thin black wire handle that arches neatly over the top of the pail, both ends fixed to the pail's rim, the handle standing straight up from the pail and touching nothing else

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.blurb: Thankful for every hour on the clock.
harvest.look: a cozy Thanksgiving harvest look: a knitted mustard-yellow scarf, a little brown pilgrim hat with a gold buckle, and a small round pumpkin pie resting against its wing

santa.name: Santa
santa.blurb: Making a list of chapters, checking it twice.
santa.look: Santa Claus: a red Santa hat with white fur trim and a white pompom, a red coat with white fur trim and a black belt with a gold buckle, and a small brown sack of presents on its back

shulk.name: Shulk
shulk.blurb: Sees the future: it's you, finishing this session.
shulk.look: Shulk from Xenoblade Chronicles: short, wavy pale-blond hair, a short wine-red jacket over a black sweater with a small pink-and-purple pattern, and the Monado slung on its back the way the other ducks carry their swords: point down, with only its thin handle and the big round ring at the base of the blade sticking up over the shoulder, and the long flat red blade (with a few thin light-blue glowing lines) hanging down behind the back. Drawn like the real Monado: the ring with a hole through it sits at the bottom of the blade next to the handle, and the handle is a long, very thin red rod coming straight down from the middle of the ring (centered under it, not off to one side), much thinner than the blade, with a tiny ring at its end

yagami.name: Yagami
yagami.look: Takayuki Yagami from Judgment: medium-length, slightly messy black hair parted in the middle, a black leather moto jacket over a plain white T-shirt, and a small wireless earpiece

eve.name: EVE
eve.blurb: Takes back the Earth, one session at a time.
eve.look: EVE from Stellar Blade: long dark-brown hair tied in a high ponytail, with long bangs framing the face, her black Planet Diving suit with white panels, small mint-green accents and a high collar, and her glowing hair band at the base of the ponytail

nagisa.name: Nagisa
nagisa.blurb: Dango, dango… a big dango family of finished sessions.
nagisa.look: Nagisa Furukawa from Clannad: short, wavy brown hair a little past the shoulders, with two thin strands sticking up from the top of the head like antennae and two small red hair clips at the sides, her pale-yellow school jacket with a white sailor collar and a red ribbon, worn plainly over the round body with no sleeves or arms showing, and the Big Dango Family sitting on its back like little plush toys: three soft, squishy dango characters in Clannad's pastel colors (one pastel pink, one pastel sky blue, one pastel mint green, all different), each a flattened, wider-than-tall oval like a squished mochi dumpling with a slightly flat bottom, never a perfect circle, no stick, skewer or plate, each with only two tiny eyes drawn as short vertical lines (like two little slits, not dots) and no mouth at all, huddled together

monokuma.name: Monokuma
monokuma.blurb: Puhuhu! Nothing despair-inducing about a finished session.
monokuma.look: Monokuma from Danganronpa: a bear hood split straight down the middle, white on the face side (left) and black on the back side (right), with two round bear ears on top (the front one white, the back one black). The hood carries Monokuma's exact face, placed like the character's: on the white half only a small round solid black dot eye and nothing else (no mouth line, no teeth on the white half); on the black half his red eye, a jagged horizontal lightning-bolt streak with sharp pointed ends; at the bottom center of the hood's face a white muzzle that straddles the middle line, with a small black nose at its top; and his grin on the black half only: a long wide grin that starts right under the nose at the middle line and sweeps up toward the back ear, lined with a row of pointed white zigzag teeth. The duck's own calm face and beak show below the hood

yuta.name: Yuta
yuta.blurb: Rika wants you to keep studying. Rika is very convincing.
yuta.look: Yuta Okkotsu from Jujutsu Kaisen 0: messy black hair falling over the forehead, the white Jujutsu High uniform jacket with a high collar and gold buttons, and his katana inside a long black cloth sword bag slung across its back, the bag's drawstring top sticking up above the shoulder

kazuma.name: Kazuma
kazuma.blurb: Luck stat maxed out: this session will go perfectly.
kazuma.look: Kazuma Satou from KonoSuba: short, messy brown hair, a green cape with a golden edge fastened at the neck over a plain gray shirt. Nothing on its back: no sword, no weapon

denji.name: Denji
denji.blurb: Dreams of jam on toast. Rips through the syllabus.
denji.look: Chainsaw Man (Denji in his chainsaw-devil form): the chainsaw devil's head as a helmet over the duck's head, rounded and orange like a chainsaw's engine casing, and it faces the same way as the duck: the long gray chainsaw bar sticks out of the FRONT of the helmet, from the forehead, pointing forward to the left and a little up (the way the duck faces), its chain lined with small silver teeth; the dark gray rear grip handle of the chainsaw sits at the BACK of the head, on the right side; a row of sharp white teeth across the helmet's jaw, with the duck's beak sticking out below; it's fine if the helmet hides the eye; a white shirt with a loose black necktie, and the small pull-cord handle of the chainsaw hanging from its chest

kid.name: Kid
kid.blurb: Perfectly symmetrical study habits. Eight sessions, exactly.
kid.look: Death the Kid from Soul Eater: short black hair with three thin white stripes on the BACK half of the hair only, the right side of the picture, away from the beak: they start at the back edge of the hair and run forward to the exact center of the head, where they stop with squared-off ends; the front half of the hair, toward the beak, is plain black with no stripes, a black suit with small white rectangle trims placed perfectly symmetrically down the front and along the sleeves, a white shirt, and at the collar his small silver-white Shinigami skull brooch: a cartoon skull with two round black eyes and exactly three long, skinny, needle-thin points hanging down from its bottom edge, the middle one longest. Nothing on its back: no guns, no weapons

randy.name: Randy
randy.blurb: Just gonna get a little bit of study time, Stan.
randy.look: Randy Marsh from South Park: short black hair combed flat, his thick black mustache sitting right on top of the beak where the beak meets the face, directly below the eye, like a mustache under a nose (not beside or under the beak), and his light blue button-up shirt, buttoned all the way up with a plain collar (no T-shirt showing)

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.blurb: Graduated from the pond. Postgrad pending.
scholar.look: a black graduation cap (a flat square mortarboard) with a gold tassel hanging at the side, a black graduation gown with a gold stole over its shoulders, and a small rolled-up diploma tied with a red ribbon tucked into the front of the stole

knight.name: Knight
knight.blurb: Sworn to protect the to-do list.
knight.look: shining silver knight armor: a rounded silver helmet with the visor raised so the face and beak show, a tall blue plume on top, a silver breastplate over a blue tabard with a small gold crest, and a longsword slung on its back point down, with only the hilt and crossguard sticking up over the shoulder

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.look: a jade-green dragon kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak: on top of the hood a tiny dragon face (two dot eyes and two dot nostrils), a row of small white teeth along the hood's front edge, two curved golden horns, a short golden mane down the back of the hood, and under the chin the hood's two ties ending in two little golden pom-poms; a row of small jade spikes down its back, a pair of little jade-green dragon wings on its back, and a short jade-green dragon tail curling out behind

tenshi.name: Angel
tenshi.blurb: Heaven is a finished to-do list.
tenshi.look: a glowing golden halo floating just above its head, and a pair of large white feathered angel wings (part of the costume, not the duck's own wing, which stays the usual one curved line) rising high from its back, with a thin pale-gold sash across its chest

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.look: a phoenix's plumage: a tall crest of long flame-shaped feathers in red, orange and gold rising from the top of its head, a long sweeping tail of the same fiery feathers rising from its tail end behind it, and a few small glowing ember sparks floating around it

kin.name: Golden
kin.look: a duck made of gold: the whole duck, its head, body and wing, is a warm gold instead of white, like a little trophy, with a small green laurel wreath on its head. Only the beak keeps its usual pale peach, and the eye is the usual small dark dot

kappa.name: Kappa
kappa.blurb: Keeps the dish full. Never skips a session.
kappa.look: a kappa costume: a ring of messy green hair around a little white dish on top of its head, and a small green turtle shell on its back

tanuki.name: Tanuki
tanuki.look: a brown tanuki hood with two round ears, a green leaf on top of the head, and a big fluffy tanuki tail with dark brown rings curling up behind it

ramen.name: Ramen
ramen.look: a white twisted headband (hachimaki) tied at the back of the head, a small navy apron, and a little steaming bowl of ramen with a pair of chopsticks sitting on its back

cowboy.name: Cowboy
cowboy.look: a brown cowboy hat with a darker band, a red bandana tied around its neck, and a small gold sheriff's star pinned on its chest

hellokitty.name: Hello Kitty
hellokitty.look: Hello Kitty: a white Hello Kitty hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with two small pointed white cat ears, her big red bow on the front ear, and Hello Kitty's face on top of the hood: two small black oval eyes, a small yellow oval nose, three black whiskers on each side, and no mouth

kuromi.name: Kuromi
kuromi.look: Kuromi: a black jester-style hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with two long black jester ears that curl at the tips, a small pink skull on the front of the hood, a pink-and-white frilly collar, and a little black devil tail with a pointed tip

cinnamoroll.name: Cinnamoroll
cinnamoroll.blurb: Flaps its ears and flies through the reading.
cinnamoroll.look: Cinnamoroll: two very long, wide, floppy white puppy ears with a pale-blue edge hanging down past the cheeks on both sides of the head, and his little curly cinnamon-bun tail

pompompurin.name: Pompompurin
pompompurin.blurb: Pudding first. Then the problem set.
pompompurin.look: Pompompurin: two floppy golden-yellow puppy ears hanging down from the top of the head, and his little dark-brown beret sitting on top, tilted slightly

totoro.name: Totoro
totoro.blurb: Waits at the bus stop, reading till it comes.
totoro.look: Totoro: a gray Totoro kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with two pointed gray ears on top, a cream belly patch with small gray chevron marks on its front, and a small green leaf resting on top of its head like a hat

tidus.name: Tidus
tidus.blurb: HA HA HA. Okay, back to studying.
tidus.look: Tidus from Final Fantasy X: short messy blond hair swept up and to the side, a yellow hooded vest with a black inner shirt and blue trim, a silver chain necklace, and his Brotherhood sword (a wavy pale-blue water-like blade with a hooked tip) slung on his back point-down with its hilt rising over his shoulder

squall.name: Squall
squall.look: Squall Leonhart from Final Fantasy VIII: shoulder-length messy brown hair, a black leather bomber jacket with a white fur collar over a white shirt, a silver lion-head pendant on a chain, and his gunblade (a silver sword with a revolver grip and a small lion charm hanging from it) slung on his back point-down with its hilt rising over his shoulder

noctis.name: Noctis
noctis.look: Noctis Lucis Caelum from Final Fantasy XV: spiky black hair swept back from his face so the eye shows, a black short jacket with a dark skull-print shirt under it and a silver ring on a chain, and his Engine Blade (a blue-gray sword with a mechanical engine hilt) slung on his back point-down with its hilt rising over his shoulder

zidane.name: Zidane
zidane.blurb: Lifts your flashcards. Returns them, mostly.
zidane.look: Zidane Tribal from Final Fantasy IX: blond hair tied in a low ponytail, a light-blue sleeveless vest over a white shirt with puffy sleeves and a small green neckerchief, and a long golden-blond monkey tail curling out behind him and up into the air

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.look: Lightning from Final Fantasy XIII: pale strawberry-pink hair falling over one shoulder, a white sleeveless Guardian Corps jacket with a brown shoulder guard and a short red half-cape hanging from the shoulder, a silver pendant, and her Blazefire Saber gunblade (a slim gray blade with a dark grip) slung on her back point-down with its hilt rising over her shoulder

terra.name: Terra
terra.look: Terra Branford from Final Fantasy VI (her Amano look): long wavy pale-green hair tied up high with a red ribbon and falling down her back, a red dress with a gold-patterned sash and a purple-red cape at the shoulders, a thin gold tiara and small gold earrings

majima.name: Majima
majima.look: Goro Majima from Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii: black hair grown long to the shoulders, swept back from the forehead with loose strands falling at the sides, a thin black goatee on the chin, his black eyepatch worn right over the eye on a thin black strap running round the head, so the eyepatch sits exactly where the eye would be and no eye shows, a short-sleeved Aloha shirt in a deep black covered in large golden-yellow and orange hibiscus flowers with green leaves, worn open over a bare chest with a thin gold chain, and his short straight-bladed knife strapped on his back, its black handle rising over the far shoulder and the blade hidden behind the body

gohan.name: Gohan
gohan.blurb: Chi-Chi said study. The universe can wait.
gohan.look: adult Ultimate Gohan from Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero: jet-black hair in long sharp spikes swept up and back, with two long pointed bangs hanging down over the forehead to the sides, a gi in a full deep violet-purple with a bright red sash tied at the waist, nothing under it

estelle.name: Estelle
estelle.blurb: Today's quest: the chapter. Reward: the next chapter.
estelle.look: Estelle Bright from Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: light brown hair in two long twin tails hanging down behind the shoulders, each held by a small metallic hair ornament, a bright red sleeveless jacket with white trim worn over a white top, a small metal shoulder guard on the far shoulder, and her long wooden bo staff slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: its upper end rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the staff runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its lower end hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

okabe.name: Okabe
okabe.blurb: El Psy Kongroo. The study plan is the Organization's.
okabe.look: Rintaro Okabe from Steins;Gate: messy black hair, a long white lab coat worn open over a dark gray shirt and khaki pants, and a small flip phone tucked in the coat's breast pocket

hachiman.name: Hachiman
hachiman.blurb: Youth is a lie. Studying alone is efficient.
hachiman.look: Hikigaya Hachiman from My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU: short black hair with one small cowlick standing up, the black Sobu High blazer over a white shirt with a loose red tie

geralt.name: Geralt
geralt.look: Geralt of Rivia from The Witcher 3: long white hair tied back in a half ponytail, a short gray stubble beard, his dark leather Kaer Morhen armor with a silver wolf-head medallion on a chain, and his two swords, one silver and one steel, slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: both hilts rise side by side over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

yui.name: Yui
yui.blurb: Gui-tah! Also: what was the question?
yui.look: Yui Hirasawa from K-On!: shoulder-length hair in a warm medium brown with straight bangs and two small yellow hair clips on one side of the bangs, the Sakuragaoka High winter uniform: a navy blue blazer (a true navy: dark but clearly blue, never black and never gray) over a white shirt with a blue ribbon, and her Gibson Les Paul guitar in cherry sunburst (a warm red-orange center fading to dark brown at the edges, with a cream pickguard) carried on the back on a strap and drawn correctly and simply, like a flat sticker of the real instrument, nothing bent, stretched or squashed: its straight neck rises over the far shoulder at the upper right and ends in a small headstock with tuning pegs, and its body shows behind the far shoulder at the right, half hidden by the duck's back, in true proportion (the body about as tall as the neck is long), its strings fine straight lines. The hair, the blazer and the instrument each keep their own clear color, so none of them melts into another.

mio.name: Mio
mio.blurb: Would rather not be watched. Studies anyway.
mio.look: Mio Akiyama from K-On!: long straight black hair with straight bangs, the Sakuragaoka High winter uniform: a navy blue blazer (a true navy: dark but clearly blue, never black and never gray) over a white shirt with a blue ribbon, and her Fender Jazz Bass in three-color sunburst (an amber center fading through red-brown to dark brown edges, with a white pickguard, four strings) carried on the back on a strap and drawn correctly, like a flat sticker of the real instrument seen straight on, nothing bent, stretched or squashed: its long neck is perfectly straight and rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, ending in a small headstock with four tuning pegs, and its whole body shows to the right of the far shoulder in the real Jazz Bass's offset shape (a slim waist, the upper horn longer than the lower), only its lower edge hidden behind the duck's back; the neck is about one and a half times as long as the body is tall, and the four strings are fine straight lines. The hair, the blazer and the instrument each keep their own clear color, so none of them melts into another.

ritsu.name: Ritsu
ritsu.blurb: Keeps the beat. Forgets the club forms.
ritsu.look: Ritsu Tainaka from K-On!: short light-brown hair pushed back by a yellow headband so her whole forehead shows, the Sakuragaoka High winter uniform: a deep navy-blue blazer (a full dark navy, never gray) over a white shirt worn open, with a loose blue ribbon, two drumsticks crossed on her back and a small bright yellow snare drum hanging behind her shoulder

mugi.name: Mugi
mugi.blurb: Tea and cake first. Then, reluctantly, the textbook.
mugi.look: Tsumugi Kotobuki from K-On!: long wavy golden-blonde hair, the Sakuragaoka High winter uniform: a navy blue blazer (a true navy: dark but clearly blue, never black and never gray) over a white shirt with a blue ribbon, and her Korg Triton keyboard carried on her back on a strap like a long flat board slanting up behind the far shoulder, drawn correctly and simply, nothing bent: a long thin dark gray body with one straight row of white keys and black keys along its top edge, in true proportion (about four times as long as it is tall), with nothing of it below the duck. The hair, the blazer and the instrument each keep their own clear color, so none of them melts into another.

azusa.name: Azusa
azusa.blurb: Azunyan! Already practicing while the others eat cake.
azusa.look: Azusa Nakano from K-On!: long black hair in two low twin tails hanging behind, the Sakuragaoka High winter uniform: a navy blue blazer (a true navy: dark but clearly blue, never black and never gray) over a white shirt with a red ribbon, and her Fender Mustang guitar in candy-apple red (a bright clear red with a white pickguard) carried on the back on a strap and drawn correctly and simply, like a flat sticker of the real instrument, nothing bent, stretched or squashed: its straight neck rises over the far shoulder at the upper right and ends in a small headstock with tuning pegs, and its body shows behind the far shoulder at the right, half hidden by the duck's back, in true proportion (the body about as tall as the neck is long), its strings fine straight lines. The hair, the blazer and the instrument each keep their own clear color, so none of them melts into another.

leon.name: Leon
leon.blurb: Raccoon City was easier than this chapter.
leon.look: Leon S. Kennedy from Resident Evil 2 remake: sandy-brown hair parted over the forehead, his dark navy R.P.D. police uniform with the shoulder patch and a black tactical vest over it, a holstered handgun at the belt and a small flashlight clipped at the shoulder

moogle.name: Moogle
moogle.blurb: Kupo! The pom-pom knows the answer.
moogle.look: a Moogle from Final Fantasy as a kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak: a white furry Moogle hood with small round ears, two small purple bat wings on the back, and a single red pom-pom bobbing on a thin antenna over the head

taiko.name: Don-chan
taiko.blurb: Don! Ka! Every answer right on the beat.
taiko.look: Don-chan from Taiko no Tatsujin as a kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak: a round red taiko drum body with a tan drumhead ring and a black swirl pattern on top of the hood, and two tan drumsticks (bachi) crossed on the back

gustave.name: Gustave
gustave.blurb: One last expedition. Then the exam.
gustave.look: Gustave from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: curly, tousled light-brown hair to the collar, a neatly trimmed short brown beard and mustache, a long fitted black coat with gold Art Deco embroidery and structured gold epaulettes on the shoulders and a deep purple scarf tucked in at the neck, his mechanical left arm shown only as a silver-and-purple plated shoulder piece high on the near shoulder with a thin glowing violet line (no arms or hands), and his sword slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

lune.name: Lune
lune.blurb: Reads every page twice. In two languages.
lune.look: Lune from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: mid-length wavy black hair falling freely around the face, parted at the side, a long asymmetrical black coat with a high collar and broad gold Art Deco panels and embroidery across the chest and shoulders (no arms or hands show: only the coat), and three small glowing orbs of colored light, her Stains, floating close behind her head: one red, one ice-blue, one green

maelle.name: Maelle
maelle.blurb: Fences through the flashcards. En garde, chapter three.
maelle.look: Maelle from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: long red hair (a deep warm auburn red, not orange) tied in a high ponytail with loose wavy strands framing the face, a fitted black jacket with structured gold-embroidered epaulettes and deep purple accents at the collar, a small gold star pin on the chest, and her slim rapier slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

sciel.name: Sciel
sciel.blurb: Draws a card. It says: keep going.
sciel.look: Sciel from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: dark hair in braids tied up at the back, a green-and-cream expedition coat with a cream collar, and her two wide crescent scythe blades strapped on her back behind the shoulders, their curves rising over the far shoulder (the duck itself stays the plain white duck)

verso.name: Verso
verso.blurb: Lost count of the expeditions. Not of the chapters.
verso.look: Verso from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: shoulder-length wavy black hair with one streak of silver-white sweeping back from the forehead, a short scraggly dark beard, a long worn dark coat in black and dark gray with gray fur at the shoulders and collar, gold epaulettes and a few leather straps with deep purple accents, and his sword slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

monoco.name: Monoco
monoco.blurb: Borrows a monster's skill. And your notes.
monoco.look: Monoco the Gestral from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, as a kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak: a hood of thick shaggy light-gray fur (a pale warm gray, never white and never dark) standing up around the face like a mane, his Gestral mask worn pushed up on top of the hood above the face: a pale bone-white mask with angular deep-red tribal markings and a tall crest of red plumes standing up from its top, a plate of pale bone armor over the near shoulder, and his tall red banner painted with pale runic marks rising on a pole over the far shoulder at the upper right, lying flat across the back the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword, with nothing of it to the right of or below the duck

shadowheart.name: Shadowheart
shadowheart.blurb: Prays the quiz is short. Shar isn't listening.
shadowheart.look: Shadowheart from Baldur's Gate 3: long black hair with straight bangs in a high ponytail bound down its length by small silver rings, a thin silver circlet across the forehead, her dark Sharran half-plate armor in black and dark gray with silver trim over a deep purple cloth, and a round shield with a mace strapped on her back

astarion.name: Astarion
astarion.blurb: Darling, the sun is out. Study inside.
astarion.look: Astarion from Baldur's Gate 3: curly silver-white hair, pointed elf ears, a dark leather doublet in deep burgundy and black with a high gold-embroidered collar over a white shirt, and two daggers tucked crossed at the back of the belt

shinguji.name: Sakura
shinguji.blurb: Stage by night, cram school by day.
shinguji.look: Sakura Shinguji from Sakura Wars (1996): long black hair in a high ponytail tied with a big red ribbon bow, the Imperial Combat Revue's kimono outfit: a soft cherry-blossom pink kimono top (a clear light pink, never magenta, salmon or purple) over a white under-robe whose collar shows at the neck, a plain violet-purple obi worn as a flat band at the waist (no bow at the front), and deep red hakama below the obi (a full crimson, never wine, brown or pink), and her katana Arataka slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

yorha.name: 2B
yorha.blurb: Emotions are prohibited. So is procrastinating.
yorha.look: 2B from NieR: Automata: a short white bob with a black headband, her black blindfold worn over the eyes (no eye shows: only the blindfold across the face), a black gothic dress with a high collar, white lace trim and puffed sleeves, and her white katana Virtuous Contract slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

amakura.name: Mio
amakura.blurb: Camera Obscura ready. Ghosts and deadlines, both caught.
amakura.look: Mio Amakura from Fatal Frame II remake: short dark brown hair in a bob, a white sleeveless blouse with a thin black ribbon at the collar and a short dark red skirt, and the antique Camera Obscura hanging from a strap at her chest

harry.name: Harry
harry.blurb: Mischief managed. Potions essay, not yet.
harry.look: Harry Potter: messy black hair with a small lightning scar on the forehead, round glasses (the duck's eye shows through one lens), the black Hogwarts robe over a gray sweater with the red-and-gold Gryffindor tie and scarf, and his wand tucked in the robe at the chest

gandalf.name: Gandalf
gandalf.blurb: You shall not pass. Without reviewing.
gandalf.look: Gandalf the Grey from The Lord of the Rings: a tall pointed gray wizard's hat, a long white beard and long gray hair, gray robes with a gray cloak, and his wooden staff slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: its top rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the staff runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its lower end hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck

spiderman.name: Spider-Man
spiderman.look: Spider-Man as a kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak: the red mask hood with thin black web lines and two large white eye lenses on top of the hood, and the red-and-blue suit with the small black spider emblem on the chest

natsu.name: Natsu
natsu.blurb: I'm all fired up! The reading list is kindling.
natsu.look: Natsu Dragneel from Fairy Tail: spiky pink hair, his white scale-patterned scarf wrapped around the neck, a black open waistcoat with gold trim, and the red Fairy Tail guild mark on the shoulder

tsuna.name: Tsuna
tsuna.blurb: Hyper Dying Will mode. Deadline, extinguished.
tsuna.look: Tsunayoshi Sawada in Hyper Dying Will Mode, as in J-Stars Victory Vs: spiky brown hair with a small orange Dying Will flame burning on the forehead, the black Namimori school blazer open over a white shirt with a loose tie, and the Vongola Sky ring on a chain around the neck

nagito.name: Nagito
nagito.blurb: Lucky the quiz got cancelled. Unlucky what cancelled it.
nagito.look: Nagito Komaeda from Danganronpa 2: fluffy wavy white hair, a dark green hooded coat with red squares on its lower half worn open over a white shirt with a red-and-brown print

chiaki.name: Chiaki
chiaki.blurb: One more level. Then, fine, one more page.
chiaki.look: Chiaki Nanami from Danganronpa 2: short light pink hair with a small white spaceship hair clip, a dark green hooded jacket open over a white shirt with a brown ribbon, and a pink handheld game console tucked in the jacket's pocket

crono.name: Crono
crono.blurb: Doesn't say a word. Turns in the essay anyway.
crono.look: Crono from Chrono Trigger: spiky bright red hair with a white headband, a white tunic with a blue sash and a light blue scarf, and his katana slung across the back exactly the way the reference's Cloud duck carries his sword: the hilt rises over the far shoulder at the upper right, the blade runs down and forward behind the body toward the lower left, lying flat across the back, its tip hidden behind the body; nothing of it sticks out to the right of or below the duck
